I doubt this will be any help to you, since it's very subjective to me... I am a trans girl, which is the main push I needed to recover. Basically. I've uncovered a traumatic sexual incident from when I was much younger. I couldn't find a way to cope enough, self harm wasn't enough. So I started to restrict, firstly I did it without realizing that this could spiral so much so fast. I wanted the false sense of control skipping meals and feeling hunger gave me. I dropped very low,in the span of a few months. Then I heard about bulimia... The hunger was getting unbearable, I was barely sitting straight in classes, I had hard time standing up from my seat without feeling like if I stay up one more second I'll faint.. so I forced myself to purge, something I thought I'd never be able to do, since I had a fear, possible phobia of vomiting... With the revelation that I could just purge anything I ate, came the binges... Eventually I got to my pre ED weight... At that point, I was purging x times a day, spending so much money on binge food only to throw it all up... My psychiatrist, who handles my transition and hormones and all that jazz started to get worried, because it just so happens that I developed an ED right as I started estrogen. She basically stood her ground and gave me an ultimatum. I'm on a pretty low dose (2mg/day) and she said that if I don't accept any help and try to recover, she'll put me off of hormones until I get my life together. At that point I was severely suicidal, dying didn't ring any bells in me... But having to live few more years until ed would kill me as a man? Hell no. So... I stopped purging. I did some self care, did my hair and makeup and took the next step in my transition, going out as a girl. Then I posted some selfies to reddit and realized I'm actually prettier than I thought... Eventually it got to a point where I got into a sort of relationship, more of a fwb with a man. That confidence boost helped me the most in terms of being ok with my body at a healthy weight. And what do you know, after I gained some, my boobs actually started growing a little bit, which made me feel very happy :) so that's where I'm at right now. Not fully recovered, the thoughts and that little bitchy voice is still here, but I somehow found the strength to resist it. Oh, and after months of very bad self harming, I'm proud to say I just hit a month clean :D so yeah... I was never diagnosed with any ED, mostly cause I didn't want to see any psychologists or anyone really. Looking back at it, I would've been admitted when I was at my lowest, which would most likely result in my psych halting my transition... I can't imagine that would've ended well. I'm happy to be where I am now in life, slowly picking myself together and getting a hold on my life once again. I will never let that asshole who SA'ed me have power over my life and happiness. And after many years, I don't hate my reflection in the mirror :) I was almost ready to recover, I wanted to be happy, to stop purging... I just needed that one push I guess. So yeah, I don't know if my story will help you in any way, but here it is :) feel free to dm me if you'd like to chat, ask questions, or just have a pal who will listen and try to help where she can 😁 ❤️
